description: This file defines the ViewEditFields class, which is responsible for rendering a form to edit relationship fields in the SuiteCRM module. It handles retrieving link definitions and generating an HTML form interface for editing related fields.

classes.name: ViewEditFields
classes.description: A class that extends ViewAjax to provide a user interface for editing relationship fields within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, retrieves relationship data, and prepares the fields for rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs an HTML form that allows editing of relationship fields for the specified module.
